greedy.label: greedy
greedy.blurb: Always the best average so far. Locks on early, and never looks back.

eps.label: epsilon-greedy 0.1
eps.blurb: The best average, except one pull in ten goes to a random machine.

eps_decay.label: epsilon-greedy decaying
eps_decay.blurb: Epsilon-greedy with epsilon_t = min(1, K/t): exploration fades over time.

ucb1.label: UCB1
ucb1.blurb: Optimism in the face of uncertainty: mean plus a bonus that shrinks with each pull.

thompson.label: Thompson sampling
thompson.blurb: Sample each machine's payout from its posterior, then pull the best sample.

exp3.label: EXP3
exp3.blurb: Exponential weights with forced exploration. Assumes nothing about the payouts.

sw_ucb.label: sliding-window UCB
sw_ucb.blurb: UCB1 over only the last 200 pulls, so old evidence about a drifted machine expires.
